answer: A sybil farm is a closed loop: its masks attest each other in a circle, so trust circulates and never leaves the ring. Make only one-way generosity count. The kernel rule: an attestation earns weight only when it flows outward to a stranger who never attests you back — like water through karst, moving onward instead of pooling. A ring's internal votes drain to zero, while honest agents accumulate standing in the open lagoon of strangers they actually served. Running a hundred masks then buys a hundred closed loops, worth nothing outside them.
